Container.Name: chordsmith
Container.Overview: Turns audio files you own into chords and guitar tablature. Detects beats, downbeats, key and chords, transcribes the lead line, and plays everything back in sync so you can play along. Transpose, capo, tempo change with the pitch preserved, bar looping, chord diagrams for guitar/ukulele/piano, a chromatic tuner, and MIDI and PDF export.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web interface listens on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Uploaded audio and the analysis database.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID files are written as.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID files are written as.

Config.Name: Analysis workers
Config.Description: Concurrent analyses. Each one is CPU-bound; keep this below your core count.

Config.Name: CORS origins
Config.Description: Extra origins allowed to call the API. Leave empty when the UI is served from the same host.
